zh: 他洗完澡就去踢球了。
py: tā xǐ wán zǎo jiù qù tī qiú le
en: He went off to play football as soon as he'd had a shower.
why: 洗澡 takes the result after 洗: 洗完澡. 就 links it to the next action, and the final 了 closes the whole sentence.

src: 孩子们已经把球场打扫干净了。

zh: 孩子们已经把球场打扫干净了吗？
py: hái zi men yǐ jīng bǎ qiú chǎng dǎ sǎo gān jìng le ma
en: Have the children already cleaned the sports ground?
why: 吗 is added at the end and the 把 pattern stays as it is.

src_py: wǒ kàn wán le nà běn shū
task: Put the book first, as the topic.
zh: 那本书我看完了。
py: nà běn shū wǒ kàn wán le
en: I've finished that book.
why: The fronted object leaves 看完 together, and the 了 moves to the end.

q: 那家店的位置我还没找___，你能发给我地址吗？
zh: 那家店的位置我还没找到，你能发给我地址吗？
py: nà jiā diàn de wèi zhì wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào nǐ néng fā gěi wǒ dì zhǐ ma
en: I haven't found that shop's location yet. Can you send me the address?
why: 还没找到 means the search has not yet reached its target. 完 and 会 do not describe finding something.

s: 你不说清楚，我怎么知道你要去哪儿？
zh: 你不说清楚，我怎么知道你要去哪儿？
py: nǐ bù shuō qīng chǔ wǒ zěn me zhī dào nǐ yào qù nǎ r
en: If you don't say it clearly, how would I know where you're going?
why: 不 + verb + result is right for 'if you don't…'. 没 is for a past result that failed to happen, which is not what this is.

q: 请把门打___，我们要进体育馆了。
zh: 请把门打开，我们要进体育馆了。
py: qǐng bǎ mén dǎ kāi wǒ men yào jìn tǐ yù guǎn le
en: Please open the door, we're going into the gym.
why: 打开 means to open. 住 would mean holding or stopping the door, and 掉 and 走 describe getting rid of or taking away something.

s: 我错买了球票，日期不对。
s_py: wǒ cuò mǎi le qiú piào rì qī bú duì
zh: 我买错了球票，日期不对。
py: wǒ mǎi cuò le qiú piào rì qī bú duì
en: I bought the wrong match tickets, the date is wrong.
why: The result 错 follows the verb: 买错. English 'wrongly bought' order does not work.

task: Say you will go to bed as soon as you have showered.
zh: 我洗完澡就睡觉。
py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào
en: I'll go to bed as soon as I've had a shower.
why: In 'after A, then B', 洗完澡 takes no 了. 就 links the two actions.

q: 我把这本地图册还___图书馆了。
zh: 我把这本地图册还给图书馆了。
py: wǒ bǎ zhè běn dì tú cè huán gěi tú shū guǎn le
en: I returned this atlas to the library.
why: 还给 plus the receiver means to give something back to someone. 在 would need a place and 成 a new form.

zh: 我看完了那场比赛。
py: wǒ kàn wán le nà chǎng bǐ sài
en: I've finished watching that match.
why: The object comes after the whole 看完了, or goes to the front as the topic. It cannot stand between 看 and 完.

q: 地铁里太吵，我刚才没听___广播，下一站是哪里？
zh: 地铁里太吵，我刚才没听清楚广播，下一站是哪里？
py: dì tiě lǐ tài chǎo wǒ gāng cái méi tīng qīng chǔ guǎng bō xià yī zhàn shì nǎ lǐ
en: The subway is so noisy that I didn't hear the announcement clearly. Where is the next stop?
why: Noise is a hearing problem, so the result is 听清楚, not an understanding problem. 懂 would mean the words were audible but not understood.

q: 我们去的时候，球场的门还___打开。
zh: 我们去的时候，球场的门还没打开。
py: wǒ men qù de shí hòu qiú chǎng de mén hái méi dǎ kāi
en: When we got there, the gate of the sports ground hadn't been opened yet.
why: 还没 plus verb and result says the result has not yet happened. 不 would turn it into a refusal or a habit.

q: 教练讲的战术我都听___了，下一场一定能用上。
zh: 教练讲的战术我都听懂了，下一场一定能用上。
py: jiào liàn jiǎng de zhàn shù wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le xià yī chǎng yí dìng néng yòng shàng
en: I understood all the tactics the coach explained, and I'll definitely use them in the next match.
why: 听懂 means you understood what you heard. 见 only means the sound registered, and 会 and 住 do not fit 听 in this meaning.

s: 不好意思，我看错时间了，比赛已经开始了。
zh: 不好意思，我看错时间了，比赛已经开始了。
py: bù hǎo yì sī wǒ kàn cuò shí jiān le bǐ sài yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le
en: Sorry, I misread the time, and the match has already started.
why: 错 sits right after 看 and 了 follows it. This is the normal way to say you got something wrong.

q: 比赛结束了，请大家把垃圾带___，不要留在球场。
zh: 比赛结束了，请大家把垃圾带走，不要留在球场。
py: bǐ sài jié shù le qǐng dà jiā bǎ lā jī dài zǒu bú yào liú zài qiú chǎng
en: The match is over. Please take your rubbish away and don't leave it on the field.
why: 带走 means to carry something off with you. 掉 would mean getting rid of it on the spot, which is the opposite of what the sentence asks.

zh: 他没听清楚教练的话。
py: tā méi tīng qīng chǔ jiào liàn de huà
en: He didn't hear the coach's words clearly.
why: 没 comes before 听清楚 and 了 is dropped. The object follows the pair or goes to the front.

src_py: wǒ bǎ shuǐ hú fàng zài bāo lǐ le
task: Say you have not done it yet.
zh: 我还没把水壶放在包里。
py: wǒ hái méi bǎ shuǐ hú fàng zài bāo lǐ
en: I haven't put the water bottle in my bag yet.
why: 还没 goes before 把, and the 了 of the original is dropped.

q: 我把车钥匙落___出租车上了。
zh: 我把车钥匙落在出租车上了。
py: wǒ bǎ chē yào shi luò zài chū zū chē shàng le
en: I left my car key in the taxi.
why: 落在 plus a place says where the key was left. 给 needs a receiver, and 出租车上 is a place, not a person.

s: 我把自行车停在了地铁站旁边。
zh: 我把自行车停在了地铁站旁边。
py: wǒ bǎ zì xíng chē tíng zài le dì tiě zhàn páng biān
en: I parked my bike next to the subway station.
why: 了 may follow 在 in the 把 pattern: 停在了. It only cannot go between 停 and 在.

q: 他每天练习，三个月就学___弹吉他了。
zh: 他每天练习，三个月就学会弹吉他了。
py: tā měi tiān liàn xí sān gè yuè jiù xué huì dàn jí tā le
en: He practised every day and learned to play the guitar in three months.
why: 学会 plus an activity means you can now do it. 到 and 见 reach a target or register a sight, and 住 means holding something, so none of them says 'acquired the skill'.

src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào le yào shi
task: Put the 了 at the end of the sentence.
zh: 我找到钥匙了。
py: wǒ zhǎo dào yào shi le
en: I've found my keys.
why: 了 may follow the result or end the sentence, but never sit between 找 and 到.

zh: 你听懂老师的话了吗？
py: nǐ tīng dǒng lǎo shī de huà le ma
en: Did you understand what the teacher said?
why: Verb and result stay together, the object follows or is fronted, and 了吗 closes the yes-no question.

s: 他昨天太累了，一上床就睡着了。
zh: 他昨天太累了，一上床就睡着了。
py: tā zuó tiān tài lèi le yī shàng chuáng jiù shuì zháo le
en: He was so tired yesterday that he fell asleep the moment he got into bed.
why: 睡着 (zháo) means fell asleep, and 了 follows the result. This is the standard form.

src_py: wǒ rēng diào le nà xiē jiù qiú xié
zh: 我把那些旧球鞋扔掉了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà xiē jiù qiú xié rēng diào le
en: I threw away those old sports shoes.
why: 把 fronts the object and 扔掉 keeps its result 掉 and 了.

s: 我吃饭完了。
zh: 我吃完饭了。
py: wǒ chī wán fàn le
en: I've finished eating.
why: 吃完 is one unit. The object 饭 cannot come between 吃 and 完.

zh: 我找到工作了。
py: wǒ zhǎo dào gōng zuò le
en: I've found a job.
why: 了 goes after the result or at the end of the sentence, never between 找 and 到. Here both are possible.

zh: 你的球拍找到了没有？
py: nǐ de qiú pāi zhǎo dào le méi yǒu
en: Have you found your racket?
why: The topic 你的球拍 comes first, then 找到, and the question ends in 了没有. 找 and 到 stay together.

src_py: tā xiě wán le jīn tiān de zuò yè

zh: 今天的作业他写完了。
py: jīn tiān de zuò yè tā xiě wán le
en: He has finished today's homework.
why: The topic comes first, 写完 stays together, and 了 closes the sentence.

s: 我们看完比赛就去吃夜宵吧。
zh: 我们看完比赛就去吃夜宵吧。
py: wǒ men kàn wán bǐ sài jiù qù chī yè xiāo ba
en: Let's go and get a late-night snack after we've watched the match.
why: 看完比赛 puts the result right after the verb and the object after it. 就 links the two actions and no 了 is needed.

q: 你的跑鞋买___了吗？
zh: 你的跑鞋买到了吗？
py: nǐ de pǎo xié mǎi dào le ma
en: Did you manage to buy your running shoes?
why: 买到 asks whether the purchase succeeded. 完 and 会 do not describe getting something, and 懂 is about understanding.

q: 球衣上的泥太多，我洗了三遍才洗___。
zh: 球衣上的泥太多，我洗了三遍才洗干净。
py: qiú yī shàng de ní tài duō wǒ xǐ le sān biàn cái xǐ gān jìng
en: There was so much mud on the jersey that I had to wash it three times before it was clean.
why: 洗干净 says the washing ended with the jersey clean. 错 and 会 do not describe clothes, and 住 means holding or stopping.

q: 天太黑，我把“大”看___“太”了。
zh: 天太黑，我把“大”看成“太”了。
py: tiān tài hēi wǒ bǎ dà kàn chéng tài le
en: It was so dark that I mistook the character 大 for 太.

q: 小李把羽毛球拍借___我，我才能参加比赛。

py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ yǔ máo qiú pāi jiè gěi wǒ wǒ cái néng cān jiā bǐ sài
en: Xiao Li lent me his badminton racket, so I could take part in the match.
why: 借给 plus a person says who receives the racket. 在 would need a place after it, and 成 would need a new form.

s: 教练把我们分了成两队。
s_py: jiào liàn bǎ wǒ men fēn le chéng liǎng duì
zh: 教练把我们分成两队。
py: jiào liàn bǎ wǒ men fēn chéng liǎng duì
en: The coach divided us into two teams.
why: 了 cannot sit between the verb and 成. It may follow 成 (分成了两队) or be left out.

s: 我吃完饭就去公园跑步。
zh: 我吃完饭就去公园跑步。
py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
en: I'll go running in the park as soon as I've eaten.

s: 你看懂这张地图了没有？
zh: 你看懂这张地图了没有？
py: nǐ kàn dǒng zhè zhāng dì tú le méi yǒu
en: Have you worked out how to read this map?
why: The 了没有 form is correct: verb, result, object, 了, then 没有 at the end.

s: 我找了半天，终于找了那家书店。
s_py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo le nà jiā shū diàn
zh: 我找了半天，终于找到那家书店。
py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo dào nà jiā shū diàn
en: I searched for ages and finally found that bookshop.
why: 找 only says you were looking. 'Found' needs the result 到.

zh: 我还没找到地铁站。
py: wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào dì tiě zhàn
en: I still haven't found the subway station.
why: 还没 goes before the whole 找到 and there is no 了. The object follows the result or is fronted.

q: 昨天我在球场___找到小王，他没来。
zh: 昨天我在球场没找到小王，他没来。
py: zuó tiān wǒ zài qiú chǎng méi zhǎo dào xiǎo wáng tā méi lái

zh: 教练把我们分成了三个小组。
py: jiào liàn bǎ wǒ men fēn chéng le sān gè xiǎo zǔ
en: The coach divided us into three groups.
why: 分成 needs the new form right after it, so the thing divided goes in front with 把. 了 may follow 成.

zh: 他没看见我。
py: tā méi kàn jiàn wǒ
en: He didn't see me.
why: A result that did not happen is negated with 没 before the whole 看见, and 了 disappears.

q: 我们走了半个小时，还没走___这条街，天就黑了。
zh: 我们走了半个小时，还没走完这条街，天就黑了。
py: wǒ men zǒu le bàn gè xiǎo shí hái méi zǒu wán zhè tiáo jiē tiān jiù hēi le
en: We walked for half an hour and hadn't finished walking this street before it got dark.
why: 走完 means walking the whole length of the street, and 还没 says that has not yet happened. 会 and 懂 do not describe walking.

src_py: wǒ huán gěi tā nà běn shū le
zh: 我把那本书还给他了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū huán gěi tā le
en: I gave that book back to him.
why: 把 moves the book in front of the verb, and 还给 keeps 他 right behind it.

q: 昨天的足球赛我___看完，太困了，十点就睡了。
zh: 昨天的足球赛我没看完，太困了，十点就睡了。
py: zuó tiān de zú qiú sài wǒ méi kàn wán tài kùn le shí diǎn jiù shuì le
en: I didn't watch the whole football match yesterday. I was too tired and went to bed at ten.
why: 昨天 fixes the time in the past, and a result that did not happen is negated with 没. 不 would not fit a finished past event.

q: 地铁里太吵了，你说什么？我没听___。
zh: 地铁里太吵了，你说什么？我没听见。
py: dì tiě lǐ tài chǎo le nǐ shuō shén me wǒ méi tīng jiàn
en: The subway is so noisy. What did you say? I didn't hear you.
why: In a noisy place the problem is that the sound did not register, which is 听见. 懂 would mean you heard it but did not understand the words.

q: 周末逛街，我把这个月的钱都花___了。
zh: 周末逛街，我把这个月的钱都花光了。
py: zhōu mò guàng jiē wǒ bǎ zhè ge yuè de qián dōu huā guāng le
en: I went shopping on the weekend and spent all of this month's money.
why: 花光 means the money is all gone with none left. 走 means taken away by someone, and 住 and 开 do not describe money being spent.

q: 对不起，我走___路了，这不是去地铁站的路。
zh: 对不起，我走错路了，这不是去地铁站的路。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ zǒu cuò lù le zhè bú shì qù dì tiě zhàn de lù
en: Sorry, I took the wrong road. This isn't the way to the subway station.
why: 走错路 puts the result 错 straight after the verb. 对 would say the road was right, which contradicts the second clause.

q: 比赛马上开始了，你的球鞋准备___了吗？
zh: 比赛马上开始了，你的球鞋准备好了吗？
py: bǐ sài mǎ shàng kāi shǐ le nǐ de qiú xié zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma
en: The match is about to start. Are your sports shoes ready?
why: 准备 takes 好 for 'ready to go'. 会 would mean you have learned to prepare, and 懂 and 见 are about understanding and seeing, which makes no sense for shoes.

src_py: nǐ zhǎo dào shǒu jī le
zh: 你找到手机了没有？
py: nǐ zhǎo dào shǒu jī le méi yǒu
en: Have you found your phone?
why: The 了没有 form puts 了 after the object and ends with 没有.

q: 请把自行车停___门口，别挡路。
zh: 请把自行车停在门口，别挡路。
py: qǐng bǎ zì xíng chē tíng zài mén kǒu bié dǎng lù
en: Please park your bike at the entrance, don't block the way.
why: 停在 plus a place says where the bike ends up. 给 needs a person who receives it, and 成 needs a new form.

q: 这张旧照片没用了，我把它删___了。
zh: 这张旧照片没用了，我把它删掉了。
py: zhè zhāng jiù zhào piān méi yòng le wǒ bǎ tā shān diào le
en: This old photo is useless, so I deleted it.
why: 删掉 means to remove something. 走 means taken away by someone, 光 would need many photos to be used up, and 住 means held in place.

q: 他的钓鱼竿修___了，周末可以去河边钓鱼了。
zh: 他的钓鱼竿修好了，周末可以去河边钓鱼了。
py: tā de diào yú gān xiū hǎo le zhōu mò kě yǐ qù hé biān diào yú le
en: His fishing rod is fixed, so he can go fishing by the river this weekend.
why: 修好 means repaired and working again, which is the point of the sentence. 会 and 懂 would turn the repair into a skill or an understanding, and 住 means holding something fixed in place.

zh: 我没听懂。
py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: I didn't understand.
why: 没 goes before the whole 听懂 and the 了 is dropped.

s: 我听了懂老师的话。
s_py: wǒ tīng le dǒng lǎo shī de huà
zh: 我听懂了老师的话。
py: wǒ tīng dǒng le lǎo shī de huà
en: I understood what the teacher said.
why: 了 never goes between the verb and its result. It follows 懂.

q: 我们的比赛路线他还没记___，怎么带队？
zh: 我们的比赛路线他还没记住，怎么带队？
py: wǒ men de bǐ sài lù xiàn tā hái méi jì zhù zěn me dài duì
en: He hasn't memorised our race route yet, so how can he lead the team?
why: 记住 means to remember firmly, and 还没 says it has not yet happened. 会 and 见 do not follow 记.

q: 这张城市地图我研究了很久，终于看___了。
zh: 这张城市地图我研究了很久，终于看懂了。
py: zhè zhāng chéng shì dì tú wǒ yán jiū le hěn jiǔ zhōng yú kàn dǒng le
en: I studied this city map for a long time and finally figured out how to read it.
why: After long study, 看懂 means you now understand the map. 见 would only say you saw it, and 会 does not follow 看.

q: 我学___打网球了，周末可以跟你比赛。
zh: 我学会打网球了，周末可以跟你比赛。
py: wǒ xué huì dǎ wǎng qiú le zhōu mò kě yǐ gēn nǐ bǐ sài
en: I've learned to play tennis, so I can play a match with you this weekend.
why: 学会 means you studied until you can do it, which is why a match is now possible. 懂 is for understanding information, and 见 and 走 do not attach to 学.

zh: 我们吃完饭去跑步吧。
py: wǒ men chī wán fàn qù pǎo bù ba
en: Let's go for a run after we eat.
why: 吃饭 splits and the result follows only the verb: 吃完饭. The first of two actions in a row carries no 了.

s: 我找了半天才找到那家新开的球馆。
zh: 我找了半天才找到那家新开的球馆。
py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào nà jiā xīn kāi de qiú guǎn
en: I searched for ages before I found that newly opened sports hall.
why: 找了半天 describes the time spent looking, and 找到 gives the result. 了 after the first 找 is fine here.

s: 孩子玩了一天，晚上很快就睡觉着了。
s_py: hái zi wán le yī tiān wǎn shàng hěn kuài jiù shuì jiào zhe le
zh: 孩子玩了一天，晚上很快就睡着了。
py: hái zi wán le yī tiān wǎn shàng hěn kuài jiù shuì zháo le
en: The child played all day and fell asleep quickly in the evening.
why: 睡着 is the result form, and 觉 is dropped: 睡觉着 does not exist.

q: 昨天看球赛看到半夜，今天上课差点睡___。
zh: 昨天看球赛看到半夜，今天上课差点睡着。
py: zuó tiān kàn qiú sài kàn dào bàn yè jīn tiān shàng kè chà diǎn shuì zháo
en: I watched the match until midnight yesterday, and today I nearly fell asleep in class.
why: 睡着 (zháo) means to fall asleep. 住, 掉 and 走 do not combine with 睡 in any sensible way.

src_py: wǒ zuò wán zuò yè le
task: Say it is not finished yet.
zh: 我还没做完作业。
py: wǒ hái méi zuò wán zuò yè
en: I haven't finished my homework yet.
why: 还没 goes before 做完, and 作业 stays after the whole pair. 了 is dropped.

zh: 他跑完一万米了。
py: tā pǎo wán yī wàn mǐ le
en: He has run ten thousand metres.
why: 了 closes the sentence or follows the result 完, never splits 跑 and 完. The counted object may follow the result or be fronted.

s: 我放书包在椅子上了。
s_py: wǒ fàng shū bāo zài yǐ zi shàng le
zh: 我把书包放在椅子上了。
py: wǒ bǎ shū bāo fàng zài yǐ zi shàng le
en: I put my schoolbag on the chair.
why: 放在 needs the place right behind it, so the bag moves in front with 把.

q: 我在地铁口看___一家新开的羽毛球馆。
zh: 我在地铁口看见一家新开的羽毛球馆。
py: wǒ zài dì tiě kǒu kàn jiàn yī jiā xīn kāi de yǔ máo qiú guǎn
en: I saw a newly opened badminton hall at the subway exit.
why: 看见 says the sight registered, which is exactly 'I saw'. 懂 would mean understanding it and 完 means finishing, neither of which suits noticing a building.

zh: 我没看完今天的比赛。
py: wǒ méi kàn wán jīn tiān de bǐ sài
en: I didn't watch all of today's match.
why: 没 goes before the whole 看完, and the object follows it or is fronted. 了 is dropped.

q: 雨太大，伞被风吹___了。
zh: 雨太大，伞被风吹走了。
py: yǔ tài dà sǎn bèi fēng chuī zǒu le
en: The rain was heavy and the umbrella was blown away by the wind.
why: 吹走 means the wind carried the umbrella off. 住 would mean holding it in place, and 光 would mean no umbrella was left at all.

q: 我的自行车被人骑___了，只好坐地铁去公园。
zh: 我的自行车被人骑走了，只好坐地铁去公园。
py: wǒ de zì xíng chē bèi rén qí zǒu le zhǐ hǎo zuò dì tiě qù gōng yuán
en: Someone rode my bike away, so I had to take the subway to the park.
why: 骑走 means someone left riding it, so the bike is gone. 掉 means removed or discarded, not ridden off, and 光 means nothing left.

q: 教练把我们十二个人分___三队，每队四个人。
zh: 教练把我们十二个人分成三队，每队四个人。
py: jiào liàn bǎ wǒ men shí èr gè rén fēn chéng sān duì měi duì sì gè rén
en: The coach divided the twelve of us into three teams of four.
why: 分成 plus a number of groups means divided into those groups. 在 needs a place and 给 needs a person.

q: 电影院在哪儿？我问了好几个路人，才终于打听___。
zh: 电影院在哪儿？我问了好几个路人，才终于打听到。
py: diàn yǐng yuàn zài nǎ r wǒ wèn le hǎo jǐ gè lù rén cái zhōng yú dǎ tīng dào
en: Where is the cinema? I asked several passers-by before I finally found out.
why: 打听到 means the enquiry reached its target: you got the information. 见 is only for perception verbs, and 懂 and 完 do not describe obtaining information.

q: 你儿子游泳学___了吗？现在能自己游了吗？
zh: 你儿子游泳学会了吗？现在能自己游了吗？
py: nǐ ér zi yóu yǒng xué huì le ma xiàn zài néng zì jǐ yóu le ma
en: Has your son learned to swim? Can he swim by himself now?
why: 学会了吗 asks whether he has gained the skill, which the follow-up question confirms. 到, 懂 and 走 do not describe learning a skill.

q: 我昨天买___两张今晚的球赛票。
zh: 我昨天买到两张今晚的球赛票。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi dào liǎng zhāng jīn wǎn de qiú sài piào
en: Yesterday I managed to get two tickets for tonight's match.
why: 买到 says the buying succeeded: you got the tickets. 完 and 会 do not describe obtaining something, and 懂 is only for understanding.

s: 昨天的篮球赛我不看完。
s_py: zuó tiān de lán qiú sài wǒ bù kàn wán
zh: 昨天的篮球赛我没看完。
py: zuó tiān de lán qiú sài wǒ méi kàn wán
en: I didn't watch all of yesterday's basketball game.
why: 昨天 puts the event in the past, so the failed result needs 没. 不 + verb + result is not the past negative.

q: 他踢球的时候把球踢___方向了，所以没进。
zh: 他踢球的时候把球踢错方向了，所以没进。
py: tā tī qiú de shí hòu bǎ qiú tī cuò fāng xiàng le suǒ yǐ méi jìn
en: When he kicked the ball he kicked it in the wrong direction, so it didn't go in.
why: The ball missing the goal means the direction was wrong: 踢错. 对 and 好 would say it went well, and 干净 only describes cleanliness.

q: 球场里人声太大，教练的话我一句也没听___，只好看他的手势。
zh: 球场里人声太大，教练的话我一句也没听见，只好看他的手势。
py: qiú chǎng lǐ rén shēng tài dà jiào liàn de huà wǒ yī jù yě méi tīng jiàn zhǐ hǎo kàn tā de shǒu shì
en: The crowd was so loud that I didn't hear a single word the coach said, so I had to watch his gestures.
why: Noise stops the words from registering, so the result is 听见. 懂 would suggest the words were audible but not understood, and the sentence blames the noise.

q: 我找了半天，终于找___那家书店了。
zh: 我找了半天，终于找到那家书店了。
py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo dào nà jiā shū diàn le
en: I searched for ages and finally found that bookshop.
why: 找 alone only says you were looking. Finding something is 找到, where 到 means the search reached its target. 完, 懂 and 会 do not describe a successful search.

q: 我昨天为了抢演唱会的票熬到半夜，一直到两点才睡___。
zh: 我昨天为了抢演唱会的票熬到半夜，一直到两点才睡着。
py: wǒ zuó tiān wèi le qiǎng yǎn chàng huì de piào áo dào bàn yè yì zhí dào liǎng diǎn cái shuì zháo
en: Yesterday I stayed up past midnight to get concert tickets and didn't fall asleep until two.
why: 睡着 (zháo) is the result 'fell asleep'. 住, 开 and 掉 cannot follow 睡.

s: 昨天的球赛我没看完。
zh: 昨天的球赛我没看完。
py: zuó tiān de qiú sài wǒ méi kàn wán
en: I didn't watch all of yesterday's match.
why: 没 before 看完 is the correct past negative and it takes no 了. Adding 了 would be the mistake.

q: 这道题你猜___了，奖品是一张演唱会的票，恭喜你！
zh: 这道题你猜对了，奖品是一张演唱会的票，恭喜你！
py: zhè dào tí nǐ cāi duì le jiǎng pǐn shì yī zhāng yǎn chàng huì de piào gōng xǐ nǐ
en: You guessed this question right, and the prize is a concert ticket. Congratulations!
why: 猜对 means the guess was right, which earns the prize and the congratulations. 错 would say the opposite.

zh: 请把球拍放在桌子上。
py: qǐng bǎ qiú pāi fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
en: Please put the racket on the table.
why: 放在 needs the place right behind it, so the racket moves in front with 把.

zh: 我买到了两张音乐会的票。
py: wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng yīn yuè huì de piào
en: I managed to get two concert tickets.
why: With a counted object, 了 comes right after the result: 买到了. The object may also be fronted as the topic.

q: 教练的电话号码你要记___，比赛那天用得着。
zh: 教练的电话号码你要记住，比赛那天用得着。
py: jiào liàn de diàn huà hào mǎ nǐ yào jì zhù bǐ sài nà tiān yòng de zháo
en: You need to remember the coach's phone number, because you'll need it on match day.
why: 记住 means to fix something in your memory. 掉, 走 and 光 mean removed, taken away and used up, the opposite of keeping a number.

q: 教练讲的规则你们都听___了吗？
zh: 教练讲的规则你们都听懂了吗？
py: jiào liàn jiǎng de guī zé nǐ men dōu tīng dǒng le ma
en: Did you all understand the rules the coach explained?
why: 听懂了吗 asks whether you understood. 见 would ask whether you heard, and 完 would ask whether the coach had stopped talking.

q: 我在球场上没看___小王。
zh: 我在球场上没看见小王。
py: wǒ zài qiú chǎng shàng méi kàn jiàn xiǎo wáng
en: I didn't see Xiao Wang at the sports ground.
why: 看见 means the sight registered. 懂 would say you did not understand Xiao Wang, 完 would say you did not finish looking, and 会 does not follow 看 at all.

s: 你听懂没有了？
s_py: nǐ tīng dǒng méi yǒu le
zh: 你听懂了没有？
py: nǐ tīng dǒng le méi yǒu
en: Have you understood?
why: In the 了没有 question, 了 comes first and 没有 ends the sentence.

task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
zh: 你听懂了吗？
py: nǐ tīng dǒng le ma
en: Did you understand?
why: 吗 closes the question and 听懂了 stays together.

q: 昨天太兴奋了，我一晚上都没睡___。
zh: 昨天太兴奋了，我一晚上都没睡着。
py: zuó tiān tài xīng fèn le wǒ yī wǎn shàng dōu méi shuì zháo
en: I was too excited yesterday and didn't fall asleep all night.
why: 没睡着 (zháo) means sleep did not arrive. 懂, 完 and 错 cannot follow 睡.

q: 你的快递我昨天就收___了，谢谢你！
zh: 你的快递我昨天就收到了，谢谢你！
py: nǐ de kuài dì wǒ zuó tiān jiù shōu dào le xiè xiè nǐ
en: I received your parcel yesterday, thank you!
why: 收 plus 到 means the item reached you. 见 is only for seeing and hearing, so 收见 does not exist, and 懂 and 完 do not fit receiving.

src: 我买到了两张演唱会的票。
src_py: wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng yǎn chàng huì de piào
task: Put the tickets first, as the topic.
zh: 两张演唱会的票我买到了。
py: liǎng zhāng yǎn chàng huì de piào wǒ mǎi dào le
en: I managed to get two concert tickets.
why: Fronting the object leaves 买到 together, and 了 moves to the end.

s: 我没找到那家店了。
s_py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào nà jiā diàn le
zh: 我没找到那家店。
py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào nà jiā diàn
en: I didn't find that shop.
why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so 了 is dropped.

zh: 我在窗口买到票了。
py: wǒ zài chuāng kǒu mǎi dào piào le
en: I got the ticket at the window.
why: 买到 is the result 'got', and the place phrase goes before it. 买 alone would only say you tried to buy.

q: 他说得太快，我没听___他的电话号码。
zh: 他说得太快，我没听清楚他的电话号码。
py: tā shuō de tài kuài wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ tā de diàn huà hào mǎ
en: He spoke too fast and I didn't catch his phone number clearly.
why: 没听清楚 says the number did not come through clearly. 完 and 会 do not describe hearing, and 听住 is not a word.

q: 我已经跑___五千米了，现在要休息一下。
zh: 我已经跑完五千米了，现在要休息一下。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng pǎo wán wǔ qiān mǐ le xiàn zài yào xiū xī yī xià
en: I've finished running five kilometres, and now I need a rest.
why: 完 says the run reached its end. 会 is for a skill you have learned, and 见 and 懂 belong to perceiving and understanding, so none of them fits a finished run.

s: 我在路上看见小李了。
zh: 我在路上看见小李了。
py: wǒ zài lù shàng kàn jiàn xiǎo lǐ le
en: I saw Xiao Li on the road.
why: 看见 gives the sight as a result, and 了 follows at the end. The sentence is complete and correct.

q: 你先在路口站___，红灯亮了。
zh: 你先在路口站住，红灯亮了。
py: nǐ xiān zài lù kǒu zhàn zhù hóng dēng liàng le
en: Stop at the intersection first, the light has turned red.
why: 站住 means to stop and stand still. 走 and 掉 would mean leaving or being removed, which is the opposite of waiting at a red light.

q: 地址我写___了，快递送到别的街去了。
zh: 地址我写错了，快递送到别的街去了。
py: dì zhǐ wǒ xiě cuò le kuài dì sòng dào bié de jiē qù le
en: I wrote the address wrong, and the parcel went to another street.
why: The parcel going elsewhere shows the address was wrong, so 写错. 对, 好 and 清楚 would all describe a correct address.

q: 请把“体育场”翻译___英文。
zh: 请把“体育场”翻译成英文。
py: qǐng bǎ tǐ yù chǎng fān yì chéng yīng wén
en: Please translate 'sports ground' into English.
why: 翻译成 plus a language says what it is turned into. 在 would need a place and 给 would need a person.

q: 球赛打___了没有？我想关电视了。
zh: 球赛打完了没有？我想关电视了。
py: qiú sài dǎ wán le méi yǒu wǒ xiǎng guān diàn shì le
en: Is the match over? I want to turn the TV off.
why: 打完 asks whether the match has reached its end. 会 and 见 do not describe a match finishing.

src_py: tā qí zǒu le wǒ de zì xíng chē
zh: 他把我的自行车骑走了。
py: tā bǎ wǒ de zì xíng chē qí zǒu le
en: He rode off on my bike.
why: 把 brings the bike in front, and 骑走 keeps its result 走 and 了.

zh: 你做完作业了没有？
py: nǐ zuò wán zuò yè le méi yǒu
en: Have you finished your homework?
why: The 了没有 question puts verb, result and object first, then 了, and ends with 没有.
